documents.summary: CTL guidance for drafting a syllabus AI policy: notes the Community Standard treats unauthorized AI as dishonesty, urges every instructor to state a course policy, and lists four sample approaches. Also covers rationale, AI literacy, attribution options, and advice against AI detectors.
documents.stance_why: The page says the Duke Community Standard sets only a 'base level policy' that 'does not explain what unauthorized means for your course', and that 'one-size-fits-all policies are neither sustainable nor reflective'. It offers sample statements ranging from prohibited to freely permitted for instructors to choose, so it sets no stance itself.

notes: No CS department or Pratt policy found; coded only the three included university-layer documents.
